name: gizza-ai/luhn-checkdigit
summary: Compute the Luhn check digit for a partial number.

tool.description: Compute the Luhn (mod-10) check digit for a partial number — the payload WITHOUT its check digit — and return the completed, valid number. Every input digit is treated as payload (unlike validation, which treats the last digit as the check digit). Used to generate valid credit/debit card, IMEI, and ID numbers. Spaces and dashes are ignored. Returns the single check digit (0-9), the cleaned payload, and the full number.

number.description: The partial number WITHOUT its check digit (the payload). Spaces and dashes are ignored.
